tags: Work from home (WFH) is a working arrangement where employees work remotely from their homes instead of an office. It's also known as telecommuting

and hybrid work. Benefits of WFH Flexibility: Employees can work from home when it's convenient for them.Work-life balance: Employees can balance their work and personal life better.Cost savings: Employers can save money on office space and other costs.WFH in practice Employees may work from home one or two days a week

or a few days a month.Employees may work from home for specifically designated time periods.Employees may need to get permission from their manager and employer to work from home.WFH job examples Virtual assistantData entry clerkSocial media managerWriterProofreader or copyeditorTutorSales representativeTranscriptionistWFH job resources LinkedIn and FlexJobs.
